teacher.title: Teacher note: What is the capital of New Zealand?
teacher.answer_preview: The capital of New Zealand is Wellington. According to Wikipedia, Wellington has been the capital since 1865, replacing Auckland as the second capital from 1841 to 1865. The first capital was Old Russell (Okiato) from 1840-1841. The decision to move the capital to Wellington was made by three Australian commissioners after a decade-long argument among parliament members.
